candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: During the second republic in Nigeria, the branch of the legislature responsible for ratifying presidential nominees for appointments was the
candidate.explanation: The Senate confirmed presidential nominations where the 1979 Constitution required legislative confirmation, including federal ministerial appointments under section 135. The House of Representatives was not the confirming chamber for those nominations.
